lenses.name: Density
lenses.description: People per km² of land. Each local administrative unit's 2021 census population (GISCO LAU) is placed on the hex of its centre, or spread evenly over the hexes within its own radius when it is larger than a hex. Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro and Kosovo have no local units: their towns and villages are counted with the population GeoNames records for them, often from an older census. Iceland's municipalities, which GISCO lists without a population, take Statistics Iceland's latest figures. Colours span the 2nd to 98th percentile of hexes; values beyond take the end colour.

lenses.name: Growth
lenses.description: Change in the region's population between 1 January 2020 and 1 January 2025 (Eurostat demo_r_pjanaggr3, NUTS 3). A change beyond ±15% is a break in the series (a census revision), left blank. United Kingdom: ONS, NRS and NISRA figures for its ITL regions. Colours span the 2nd to 98th percentile of hexes; values beyond take the end colour.

lenses.name: Median age
lenses.description: Median age of the region's residents on 1 January (Eurostat demo_r_pjanind3, NUTS 3). United Kingdom: ONS, NRS and NISRA figures for its ITL regions. Colours span the 2nd to 98th percentile of hexes; values beyond take the end colour.

lenses.name: Seniors
lenses.description: Share of the region's residents aged 65 or over on 1 January (Eurostat demo_r_pjanaggr3, NUTS 3). United Kingdom: ONS, NRS and NISRA figures for its ITL regions. Colours span the 2nd to 98th percentile of hexes; values beyond take the end colour.

lenses.name: Children
lenses.description: Share of the region's residents under 15 on 1 January (Eurostat demo_r_pjanaggr3, NUTS 3). United Kingdom: ONS, NRS and NISRA figures for its ITL regions. Colours span the 2nd to 98th percentile of hexes; values beyond take the end colour.

lenses.name: Life expectancy
lenses.description: Life expectancy at birth, both sexes (Eurostat demo_r_mlifexp, NUTS 2, latest year published). United Kingdom: the mean of men's and women's life expectancy by local area (ONS). Colours span the 2nd to 98th percentile of hexes; values beyond take the end colour.

lenses.name: GDP per person
lenses.unit: € per inhabitant, in purchasing power standards
lenses.note: GDP is counted where it is produced: regions with many commuters coming in (city centres, Luxembourg) look richer than their residents are.
lenses.description: Gross domestic product per inhabitant in purchasing power standards (PPS, EU27 = euros at average EU prices), so price levels are comparable across countries (Eurostat nama_10r_3gdp, NUTS 3). A region without a figure takes its larger region's; Iceland and Bosnia and Herzegovina, which publish no regional figure, the national accounts' (nama_10_pc), and Switzerland its PPS volume index times the EU level. Kosovo and Liechtenstein have none. United Kingdom: ONS, NRS and NISRA figures for its ITL regions. Colours span the 2nd to 98th percentile of hexes; values beyond take the end colour.

lenses.name: Household income
lenses.description: Net disposable income of private households per inhabitant, in purchasing power standards (Eurostat nama_10r_2hhinc, NUTS 2): what households have left to spend or save after taxes and with social transfers. Iceland, Switzerland, Albania, Montenegro, North Macedonia, Serbia and Kosovo publish no such account: their national figure is estimated from the EU-SILC survey's mean income, times the median ratio between the two measures in the countries that have both. Bosnia and Herzegovina and Liechtenstein have none. United Kingdom: gross disposable household income per head (ONS), a little above the net measure. Colours span the 2nd to 98th percentile of hexes; values beyond take the end colour.

lenses.name: Poverty
lenses.unit: at risk of poverty or social exclusion
lenses.description: Share of people at risk of poverty or social exclusion (AROPE: below 60% of the national median income, severely deprived, or in a household with very low work intensity), Eurostat ilc_peps11n, NUTS 2. The poverty line is national, so the rate compares people with their own country. The United Kingdom publishes no regional rate on this definition: blank. Colours span the 2nd to 98th percentile of hexes; values beyond take the end colour.

lenses.name: Unemployment
lenses.unit: unemployed among the labour force aged 15-74
lenses.description: Unemployment rate, ILO definition, ages 15-74 (Eurostat lfst_r_lfu3rt, labour force survey, NUTS 2). United Kingdom: Annual Population Survey, ages 16 and over. Colours span the 2nd to 98th percentile of hexes; values beyond take the end colour.

lenses.name: Employment rate
lenses.description: Share of people aged 20-64 in employment (Eurostat lfst_r_lfe2emprt, NUTS 2). United Kingdom: Annual Population Survey, ages 16-64. Colours span the 2nd to 98th percentile of hexes; values beyond take the end colour.

lenses.name: University degrees
lenses.unit: share of 25-64 year-olds with tertiary education
lenses.description: Share of people aged 25-64 with tertiary education, ISCED levels 5-8 (Eurostat edat_lfse_04, NUTS 2). United Kingdom: Annual Population Survey, qualifications at level 4 or above, ages 16-64. Colours span the 2nd to 98th percentile of hexes; values beyond take the end colour.

lenses.name: Forest
lenses.description: Share of the hex's land covered by broadleaf, coniferous or mixed forest (CORINE classes 311-313).

lenses.name: Farmland
lenses.description: Share of the hex's land in crops, vineyards, orchards, olive groves, pastures and mixed farming (CORINE classes 211-244).

lenses.name: Built-up
lenses.description: Share of the hex's land that is built up: urban fabric, industrial and commercial areas, transport networks, construction sites (CORINE 111-133; green urban areas do not count).

lenses.name: Vineyards
lenses.description: Share of the hex's land in vineyards (CORINE class 221). Colours span the 2nd to 98th percentile of hexes; values beyond take the end colour.

lenses.name: Olive groves
lenses.description: Share of the hex's land in olive groves (CORINE class 223). Colours span the 2nd to 98th percentile of hexes; values beyond take the end colour.

lenses.name: Orchards
lenses.description: Share of the hex's land in fruit trees and berry plantations (CORINE 222). Colours span the 2nd to 98th percentile of hexes; values beyond take the end colour.

lenses.name: Density since 1975
lenses.description: People per km² of land every five years from 1975 to 2020: drag the slider or press Play. From the European Commission's Global Human Settlement Layer (GHS-POP R2023A), which spreads each country's census counts over the built-up areas that Landsat and Sentinel-2 saw at each date, on a 1 km grid. From 1975 to 2020 the Madrid region grows by about 70% and Ireland's east by two thirds, while Castile and León, Extremadura and the Alentejo lose 10 to 15%, Saxony-Anhalt and Thuringia nearly a quarter, Latvia a quarter and Bulgaria a fifth. Same colours for every year, those of the Density lens.

lenses.name: Temperature
lenses.description: Mean air temperature at 2 m over 2000-2019 (ERA5 reanalysis downscaled to 1 km with CHELSA, sampled every 5 km): relief first, then latitude and the sea. Colours span the 2nd to 98th percentile of hexes; values beyond take the end colour.

lenses.name: Warming
lenses.note: One decade (2010-2019) against the one before (2000-2009): over so short a span, a few unusual years weigh on the difference.
lenses.description: Change in the mean temperature between 2000-2009 and 2010-2019 (ERA5/CHELSA). A thirty-year comparison would be steadier; this is what the 1 km monthly series allows. Colours span the 2nd to 98th percentile of hexes; values beyond take the end colour.

lenses.name: Rainfall
lenses.description: Yearly precipitation (rain and snow) averaged over 2000-2018 (CHELSA, 1 km, read at about 8 km): from the soaked western slopes (Norway's coast, the Alps, the Dinaric Alps) to the dry south-east of Spain. Colours span the 2nd to 98th percentile of hexes; values beyond take the end colour.

lenses.name: Rainfall change
lenses.note: Rainfall varies a lot from year to year: a decade-to-decade change mixes trend and chance.
lenses.description: Yearly precipitation in 2010-2018 compared with 2000-2009 (CHELSA). Colours span the 2nd to 98th percentile of hexes; values beyond take the end colour.

lenses.name: Forest height
lenses.unit: m, mean height of the forests
lenses.description: Mean canopy height of the hex's forests (CORINE classes 311 to 313), from ETH Zurich's 2020 map of the world's canopy height: a deep network learned the heights NASA's GEDI LiDAR measured from the International Space Station, then estimated them everywhere from Sentinel-2 images at 10 m. Read here at about 300 m, at the hex's forest land-cover points (10 at least). The Alpine and Dinaric forests of Switzerland, Slovenia and Austria average 25 m, Finland's and Norway's boreal forests 13 m, Iberian woodland 10 to 11 m. The outermost regions are not covered. Colours span the 2nd to 98th percentile of hexes; values beyond take the end colour.
